home.storyP1: For generations, Kannauj has distilled flowers, woods and earth into attar in copper degs over wood fires. We bring that patience together with the oud and musk traditions of Arabia.
home.storyP2: Every bottle is alcohol-free, skin-safe and made in small batches — the way your grandfather's attar box smelled, only fresher.
home.quizSub: Three quick questions. We'll suggest three attars — and our team will guide you on WhatsApp.
home.spotlightSub: Burn a chip of bakhoor on charcoal to welcome guests. Rub a dab of oud on your wrists. Moattar — smoke-scented cloth — keeps the fragrance in your clothes for days.
